secrets_handling.credentials_source: environment only (TRADELOCKER_EMAIL, TRADELOCKER_PASSWORD, TRADELOCKER_SERVER, optional TRADELOCKER_DEV_API_KEY)
secrets_handling.secret_scan: source audit: no email/password literals in runner or provider modules (test-enforced); fixture credentials exist only in FakeTradeLocker/tests and are documented as fixtures
secrets_handling.header_logging_scan: code-only tokenize scan proves no print()/logging usage in real provider modules (test-enforced)

write_barriers.barrier_2_session_guard: ReadOnlyTradeLockerBrokerSession raises ReadOnlyProviderWriteForbiddenError on submit/close/cancel; never fake success
write_barriers.barrier_3_transport_deny: ReadOnlyTransport denies every non-GET except /auth/jwt/token and /auth/jwt/refresh before it leaves the process
write_barriers.barrier_4_capability_profile: can_submit_new_risk=false; demo-only environment gate refuses any non-demo base URL before connection
